blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Police arrested a 38-year-old man considered the third most-wanted person in the Ilocos region on Monday. The suspect, a native of San Juan, Abra, was arrested in Barangay 93, Bagacay, Tacloban City, by personnel from the Santo Domingo Municipal Police Station and other police units. According to the Ilocos Sur Provincial Police Office (ISPPO), the arrest was made by virtue of warrants issued for three counts of qualified rape, for which no bail was recommended, and two counts of lascivious conduct, with bail set at P120,000 for each case.
